messages:
molly: Quick idea — want to run a focused 2-week microtest on the pricing page focused on naming + calculator phrasing for EMEA. Instead of 'Enterprise / Dedicated / Hosted' I want to try 'Tariff: Scale / Tariff: Isolated / Hosted' (yes, using 'Tariff' deliberately for UK audience). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
raj: Love the experiment angle. Metric suggestion: inbound contact rate (calc -> contact sales CTA) + lead quality (sql rate) + pricing FAQ clicks. Keep it small though. :+1:
sophia: 'Tariff' is bold — we should A/B copy variants. Variant A uses 'Tariff — Scale' with a short one-liner, Variant B uses 'Scale (Tariff)' — we can test which reduces confusion. I'll mock both in Figma. :paintbrush:
kyle: Implementation-wise we can toggle labels via feature-flag and run split on the client. Also update the calculator microcopy so that the estimated monthly cost lines read more like an invoice preview. I can push a small JSON flag mapping, e.g.:
```json
{
  "pricing_label_variant": "tariff_a",
  "calculator_cta_map": {
    "scale": "sales_scale_queue",
    "isolated": "sdr_isolated_queue",
    "hosted": "selfserve_flow"
  }
}
```
raj: Perfect — add an event for `pricing_calc_view` + `pricing_calc_contact_click` and tag by variant. We'll need to see funnel from calc -> contact -> demo booked.
ben: Heads up from Sales: if we route more 'isolated' picks to the SDR queue we need a quick playbook for high-intent signals (committed usage > $10k/mo). Otherwise SDR will get too many low-quality leads. Can we add a pre-routing filter?
elaine: Ops question: do we need any FAQ copy updates for legal/compliance? If 'Tariff' is new terminology, CS and Legal should sign off on the sample contract line. I can draft a short blurb for the FAQ: one-sentence definition + link to dedicated docs.
sophia: I'll add an inline tooltip for 'Tariff' definition on hover and a microcopy link to FAQ (short). That should cut down on support questions.
kyle: For the pre-routing filter, we can add a hidden field in the calc that captures 'commit_level' (none, 3mo, 12mo) and only send high-commit leads to SDR. Quick pseudo: `if commit_level in ["12mo"] or est_monthly > 10000 -> route to sdr`
molly: Nice. Can we also align the webinar messaging? Planning to run a short webinar on 'Optimizing inference economics' and highlight the new calculator flow. Use the experiment to drive signups and measure conversion uplift.
ben: Webinar promo — Sales can host a dedicated slot for outbound follow-ups after the webinar. Suggest we reserve 2 SDRs for follow-ups for 48h post-webinar.
elaine: Deploy timeline? Kyle, can we get the flag and calc changes in staging by Wednesday so design can QA?
kyle: Yeah, feature flag and routing mapping ready by Tue EOD, staging deploy Wed morning. Deploy-bot: staging deploy queued — build #4987.
molly: Action items: Sophia -> Figma variants by Mon EOD; Kyle -> flag + calc logic in staging by Tue EOD; Raj -> tagging + analytics events; Ben -> SDR playbook draft; Elaine -> FAQ blurb + legal check. We'll review results after 2 weeks. Everyone OK with owners? :eyes:
